$description: Herú design tokens (W3C DTCG). One primitive: unit = 4px. Everything else is unit multiples or density-driven. No color tokens yet.

unit.$description: The only primitive. Emitted as 0.25rem so it scales with user font size.

density.$description: Unit-count multipliers that change per density mode. Select a mode with data-heru-density on any element; default also applies on :root.

pad-units.$description: Control block padding in units (each side).

pad-inline-units.$description: Control inline padding in units (each side).

control-sm-units.$description: Small control height in units (6/8/10 → 24/32/40px). Set directly so compact sm stays at the 24px WCAG 2.2 target size.

space.$description: Page and layout spacing. space-N = N × unit (N × 4px). Fixed across density modes.

radius.$description: Corner radius, odd-pixel ramp. radius-N = N px. Exempt from the 4px grid. Controls use radius-5.

border.$description: Border widths. Borders are drawn inside control heights (box-sizing: border-box).

leading.$description: Density-driven line height used for control text and to derive control heights.

control.$description: Interactive control sizing. md = leading.body + pad × 2; lg uses one more pad unit; sm is a per-mode unit count (6/8/10) so it never drops below 24px.

size.$description: Font sizes named by their px value at the default 16px root. font-size-N = N px.

line-height.$description: Line heights named by px value; every one is a multiple of 4px. line-height-N = N px.

text.$description: Semantic text roles. Each role = size + line-height + weight (+ family). Use these in components; use the numeric scales only when no role fits.

color.$description: Minimal palette in OKLCH: one dark slate ramp and one error red. Use the semantic names (color-bg, color-text, …), not the ramps.

slate.$description: Dark slate ramp (hue 260, low chroma). The only non-error ramp. 0 = white, 950 = near-black with a blue tint.

0.$description: Hue 260 (not 0) so color-mix() in oklch never swings through red; chroma 0 = pure white.

red.$description: Error ramp (hue 27). 50 subtle fill, 600 borders/icons, 700 text.

500.$description: Base of the error surface tint (exact former error-surface hue/chroma).

800.$description: Status text on the error surface (exact former error-status-text).

text-muted.$description: Secondary text: descriptions, placeholders. AA on bg and surface.

border-strong.$description: Border that must be visible (hover, inputs needing 3:1).

border-popup.$description: Popup/listbox outline: a step darker than border (2.64:1 on bg; decorative, the elevation carries the edge).

accent-hover.$description: DEPRECATED for direct use: fallback for browsers without color-mix(); states now come from the shared state layer.

accent-active.$description: DEPRECATED for direct use: fallback for browsers without color-mix() (pressed).

surface-hover.$description: Fallback only (no color-mix): hovered item on bg. Prefer the state layer.

surface-pressed.$description: Fallback only (no color-mix): pressed item on bg. Prefer the state layer.

shadow-urgent.$description: Base colour of the urgent (error) elevation.

error-text.$description: Error message text. AA on bg.

error-surface.$description: Error box fill: red-500 at 8% (== oklch(0.586 0.226 21.3 / 0.08)).

state.$description: Shared state layer (NAME PENDING — Technical Writer). Percent of a surface's on-colour mixed into its fill: color-mix(in oklch, var(--_bg), var(--_on) <state>). Implemented once in src/internal/state-layer.ts. Selected+hover = selected + hover.

selected.$description: Selected/current/checked. Always paired with a non-colour indicator.

focus.$description: Focus indicator that grows in: ring-offset gap (1px) in color-bg, a ring-width ring (2px, ring-blur edge) in color-focus-ring, then a halo-width halo (1px). Total reach = 4px, so label (space-1) and description (space-2) gaps stay normal.

ring-blur.$description: Slight softening of the ring edge.

halo-width.$description: Soft halo band visible past the ring's outer edge.

halo.$description: Alias of color-focus-halo (kept for existing references).

duration.$description: Motion durations. NAME PENDING — Technical Writer (provisional). Zeroed (0.01ms) under prefers-reduced-motion by the theme.

default.$description: Focus-ring grow-in; settle time of ease.spring.

slow.$description: Popup slide-down; settle time of ease.spring-bouncy.

ease.$description: Easing curves. NAME PENDING — Technical Writer (provisional). Springs are generated by scripts/spring.mjs as CSS linear(); $value is the cubic-bezier fallback for engines without linear().

standard.$description: Default for colour, border and the error box (never springy).

spring.$description: Critically damped (ζ≈1), no overshoot. Pair with duration.default.

spring-bouncy.$description: Underdamped (ζ≈0.72), ~4% overshoot. Pair with duration.slow. Transforms only.

elevation.$description: Shared elevation foundation (NAME PENDING — Technical Writer). Three semantic levels usable by any raised surface: popovers, menus, dialogs, field status. Built from color-shadow (slate-950) and color-shadow-urgent (red-600) via color-mix(); the build emits literal fallbacks for browsers without color-mix().

default.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 6%, transparent), 0 4px 12px -2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 12%, transparent)
default.$description: Resting raised surface: open menu, popover.

hover.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 8%, transparent), 0 2px 6px -1px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow} 16%, transparent)
hover.$description: Interactive item on hover/press (lifts within a raised surface).

urgent.$value: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow-urgent} 12%, transparent), 0 4px 12px -2px color-mix(in oklch, {color.shadow-urgent} 24%, transparent)
urgent.$description: Error-urgent: attached error/status box. Tinted from red-600.
